title: Scientists have drawn a treasure map of where fossils of ancient sea life are still to be found
summary_full: In an exciting development, researchers have pinpointed potential hotspots for fossil discoveries that remain undocumented. Focusing on the Cenozoic Era, celebrated for its rich marine biodiversity, this study seeks to enhance fossil hunting by concentrating efforts on less explored territories. Additionally, revisiting collections from natural history museums could yield new insights into ancient species, reinforcing the pursuit of understanding marine life from the past.
